test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The teacher was happy to meet her and asked, “When did you complete all these?”

options.text: The teacher was happy to meet her and asked when she had completed all those.
The teacher was happy to meet her and asked when she had been completing all those.
The teacher was happy to meet her and asked when did she complete all those.
The teacher was happy to meet her and asked when had she completed all those.

solution:
The correct answer is:** 'The teacher was happy to meet her and asked when she had completed all those.'**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is **Interrogative sentence.**
 
• While changing narration of** interrogative sentences -**
 
 
• ​First off all **remove commas and inverted commas**.
 
• If the reported speech is in the form of **WH-Question** (who/what/why/how/where/when/which etc.), then:
 
 
• To make indirect speech, the question is changed into **assertive (positive) form** and simply placed after the reporting verb.
 
• There is an **inversion **of **subject and verb** during conversion.
 
 
 
• Also, in the given sentence** reporting verb **is in** past tense**, thus we make the following change-
 
 
• **Simple past tense (did)** will change in **Past perfect tense (had)** and in Past perfect tense we use **verb's 3rd form (completed).**
 
 
 
• **"You"** is the **second person pronoun **so **"you"** will change according to the** object ("her")** of reporting verb.
 
 
• **"You"** will change to **"she".**
 
 
 
• In given sentence "**these"** is a **time and distance indicator word **so it will change into** 'those'.**
 
• **'Asked' will not change.**
 
• The sign of **interrogation (?)** is removed and full stop is used.
 
• The sentence with the quotation marks under the direct speech,** '****When did you complete all these?'** becomes** 'when she had completed all those'** in indirect speech. 
 
 

**​​****Thus, the correct sentence is: ***The teacher was happy to meet her and asked when she had completed all those.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **interrogative sentence** is a sentence that **asks a ****question** and **always ends with a ****question mark.**
 
• The words like, this, these, tomorrow, yesterday change to that, those, the next day, the previous day **respectively.**
